  1. jwat

Uses of Package
jwat

Packages that use jwat
Package
Description
jwat
The JWAT tool: workload characterization, as described in the user manual.
jwat.filters
Filters applied by JWAT to the imported workload data (scaling, sampling, outlier filtering, ...).
jwat.fitting
Distribution fitting of the JWAT tool, including the Gulati-Shapiro test for the Pareto distribution.
jwat.fitting.panels
Panels of the JWAT distribution fitting views.
jwat.fitting.utils
Utilities of the JWAT distribution fitting views.
jwat.input
Input file formats of JWAT: standard formats such as Apache HTTP and IIS logs, plus user customized formats.
jwat.trafficAnalysis
Traffic analysis support of JWAT: aggregation and analysis of arrival data.
jwat.trafficAnalysis.panels
Panels of the JWAT traffic analysis views.
jwat.workloadAnalysis
Workload analysis model of JWAT: the observations, variables and parameters of the workload characterization process.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.chart
Chart components of the JWAT workload analysis (histograms, boxplots, scatterplots, ...).
jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.fuzzyKMean
Fuzzy k-means clustering algorithm of JWAT (originally coded in Fortran in 1983 and migrated to Java in 2006).
jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.fuzzyKMean.panels
Panels of the JWAT fuzzy k-means clustering view.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.kMean
K-means clustering algorithm of JWAT.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.kMean.panels
Panels of the JWAT k-means clustering view.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.panels
Panels of the JWAT workload analysis wizard.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.tables
Tables of the JWAT workload analysis views.
jwat.workloadAnalysis.utils
Utilities of the JWAT workload analysis (session management, variable listeners, model helpers).
